about: The secreta of the formulary “Saint Lawrence, Martyr” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Graciously receive, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts offered, and, by the interceding merits of blessed Lawrence, grant that they may further our salvation. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
